title: handoff-to-deploy input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage release-handoff.

verdict.description: qa-validate's suite verdict. Release is permitted ONLY for PASS — FAIL/ERROR is an explicit stop; there is no lowercase 'conditional' (a human exception is a gate decision, not an input value).

totals.description: Shape: executing-qa-test-suite schemas/output.json#/properties/totals. Full evidence via upstream_artifacts["qa-validate"].

release_ref.description: Optional workflow input: immutable release reference. Live mode stops needs-input without it.

target_env.description: Optional workflow input: target environment. Live mode stops needs-input without it.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key. Handoff idempotency identity is (idempotency_key, release_ref, target_env).

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: producer stage id -> artifact path; the full QA evidence pointer.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run.
